finalText:
**Redis died, and the app followed it down.**

| Time | Event |
|---|---|
| 02:14:07 | `redis connection lost: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379` |
| 02:14:10 | Cache miss storm, first `TimeoutError` at 5000ms |
| 02:15:26 → 02:31:26 | 13 reconnect attempts, all refused |
| 02:31:44 | `worker-2` heap out of memory, exit 134 |
| 02:31:52 | `FATAL [supervisor] api unresponsive, killing process group — service down` |

Redis never came back. All reads hit the store direct. Queue depth climbed from 52 to 568 against a max of 500. That backlog ate the heap.

Fix Redis at `10.0.0.12:6379` first. Then add load shedding above the 500 cap. See [app.log:182](logs/app.log#L182).
